pensamiento:
I'm checking each user story against the criteria. QUS-001 has a role and an action but no stated benefit, which the template only suggests, so it still passes. QUS-002 doesn't mix objectives, so it passes too. QUS-003 passes, and QUS-004 doesn't.

I'm weighing QUS-004 next: it has no stated benefit, so I'll flag that under INV-002 rather than mark the story itself as failing. QUS-006 is vague with "various type" and no defined forms, so that's a major defect. QUS-007 and QUS-008 look like related stories in different contexts, though QUS-008 overlaps somewhat with CTX-CP-042 and might be worth noting.

I'm going through the remaining invariants now. INV-001 looks fine as far as I can tell, since nothing says it depends on another story. INV-002 fails because there's no stated benefit, and INV-003 fails too because the forms, fields, and workflow are undefined. For INV-004 I can't really estimate the scope, so I'll hold off on a verdict until that's clearer.

I'm now going through the DOR criteria, and the "camp management" mention stands out: it names a system without saying which service receives the forms, so I'll count that as a major defect since the integration isn't identified. I'm also deciding not to score the "various type of forms" scope as a separate defect, since the vagueness is already captured under the other findings.

I'm checking DOR-002 next: there are no stated limits, validations, or error cases for the form submission, and the form types are undefined, so I'll mark it as a major defect. DOR-003 doesn't clearly involve critical or high volume, so I'm leaving it as not applicable. QUS-009 follows the same English "As a parent, I want to..." format as the other stories, so it passes, and the missing title isn't a criterion I need to score.

I'm settling on a verdict of devolver, with an estimate of 1 since the scope can't be sized. I'm drafting the refined story now, but I can't fill in a benefit the user never gave, so the form type will need to stay open.

I'm settling the defect list and the verdict: the story goes back for rework, with the estimate set to 1 since its scope can't be sized. I'm writing one recommendation per defect, adding the open questions, and noting the empty title in my report.
